templates.title: Agent templates
templates.description: House templates: the GUIDU Assistant template of every partner and the GUIDS any customer can start from.

form.name: Template name
form.createHint: Start with the name. The configuration of the five tabs comes next, in the same panel.
form.published: Published (customers see it when creating a GUIDS)
form.publishedAdmin: The Assistant's template is always published
form.invalidStored: The stored configuration of this template is not valid. Review the tabs and save again.
form.deleteMessage: Delete the template {name}? GUIDS created from it keep the configuration they already have.

backup.title: AI backup
backup.description: Platform key and cheap model used only to finish, for up to 24 hours, the open conversations of a GUIDS whose customer key failed. It does not count toward the customer's usage.
backup.off: Without a key and model the backup is off: a GUIDS stops answering as soon as the customer's key fails.

form.keyHint: Leave blank to keep the saved key. The key is encrypted and shown masked only.
form.clearKey: Remove the key (turns the backup off)
